objects.descriptor: Exact canonical CBOR route-context hash, seq/derived ID, operation, original issue/expiry and full mixed mechanism shape including action digest, domain/snapshot, accountant, public capacity, B/K, codec and catalog labels/digest.
objects.envelope: Sender COSE in RetentionDeliveryEnvelopeV2 domain; exact descriptor bytes and complete fixed-width result.
objects.control: Sender COSE in RetentionDeliveryTerminalV2 domain; exact same descriptor and empty or original signed envelope SHA256. No result.
objects.attempt: Sender COSE in RetentionDeliveryAttemptV2; DELIVERY/TERMINAL kind, signed body, fresh challenge. Both signatures checked.
objects.receipt: Receiver COSE in RetentionDeliveryReceiptV2; canonical retention fact, fresh challenge, exact signed attempt SHA256.

fact_derivation.accepted: Verify complete signed envelope and vector semantics; derive descriptor/action/ID/window from it; envelope_hash is SHA256 of exact signed envelope; event must lie in original validity interval.
fact_derivation.closed: Verify signed control and derive same descriptor/action/ID/window, envelope_hash from control; event must be at or after original expiry.
fact_derivation.audit: verify_fact_evidence reconstructs the entire canonical fact from signed original evidence and stored first-event time and requires byte equality.
fact_derivation.reconciliation: Existing terminal fact must match exact descriptor and original envelope binding. ACCEPTED with an empty envelope hash is invalid. Ordinary delivery rejects CLOSED. Retried ordinary/terminal/final-query receipts carry identical fact bytes for the same stored event.

real_job_fixture.source: signed encrypted shared-account jobs; offline encoding only, no v2 L3 or network admission

validation.source_hashes: All transitive local source imports plus CDDL and deterministic vectors recorded in report.
negative_controls: Trusted gateway can sign a different but range-valid result without proving computation; admission must bind actual committed output.
Trusted receiver can sign two in-window first times without persistent uniqueness; receiver transaction and sender consistency checks remain mandatory.

integration_plan.sender_L3: Use a new storage profile, not implicit v1 migration. Within one sender authority transaction: authenticate/current authority, validate existing signed operation and publication gate, bind a stable admission request key to operation+route+requested TTL, allocate monotonic unsigned sequence, derive ID, create L3 ticket and immutable canonical descriptor, and register outbox. A retry resolves the same assigned sequence; it must not allocate another sequence before checking its saved request binding.
integration_plan.sender_prepare: Read actual COMMITTED result with existing authenticated decryption and result binding; compare all public metadata to admitted descriptor; sign/persist exact envelope before any transmission. No fresh sampling or cost refund.
integration_plan.sender_confirm: Verify receipt against original signed request and envelope/control, compare stored final fact if already confirmed, archive evidence and advance only the contiguous confirmation frontier in one authority transaction; only then allow retirement offer signing.
integration_plan.receiver_first_event: Under one write lock and current authority fence: update monotonic clock; reject sequence<=retired floor, check exact next sequence and public live-window capacity, verify complete incoming evidence, establish ACCEPTED/CLOSED exactly once and store its fact plus recoverable evidence. Terminal admission also requires current time>=original expiry. Authority accepts before local commit and reply.
integration_plan.receiver_retire: Use pure retention transition only against current authoritative live records; atomically delete prefix/advance floor+root while retaining high water and clock. Reply after authority/local commit. Recover uncertain commits before proceeding.
integration_plan.unsigned_storage: Use exact uint64 representation such as fixed 8-byte big-endian BLOBs with explicit length/type checks; preserve order and exhaustion. Do not store full range in SQLite signed INTEGER.
integration_plan.archival_boundary: Sender admission request bindings, full evidence, privacy spending and witness history are not deleted by receiver record compaction; capacity is not globally bounded.

remaining: Scalable authority/history storage and bounded aggregate resources; receiver current-image admission implemented

This is an integration fixture, not a production deployment/management API or complete public observation protocol.
